column1: #mapping_set_description: New Ensembl metadata API /api/metadata/genome/{genome_id}/karyotype; one record per karyotype region. /top-regions returns the same shape (identical for the two anchor genomes).

column9: Lossy: The new API says yeast Mito is not circular; legacy REST and the core database say it is.
Always 'chromosome' (also for MT); not a molecule type.
